title: melanoseris hastata
intro: Melanoseris hastata, commonly known as the needle flower, is a type of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Melanoseris hastata include reducing inflammation, improving immune function, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
